list.title: How to Use?
list.content:
Step 1
On damp face, gently massage the face wash for 1-2 minutes
Step 2
Rinse with water and pat dry.
For best results, use it once a day for 3 months.

list.title: Important Information
list.content: To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use this 2.5% Benzoyl Peroxide regularly and consistently for 3-4 months.  We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:  1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow   2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product, else you can safely use it.

list.title: When is the ideal time to use the face wash?
list.content: This facewash is suitable for both AM/PM routine. Start by using once a day and then once you are used to it, continue using twice a day

list.title: Is the facewash safe for sensitive skin?
list.content: The facewash suits all skin type. However, we recommend doing a patch test first.

list.title: How does Benzoyl Peroxide help in acne?
list.content: Benzoyl Peroxide help reduce acne by killing bacteria and germs on the surface of your skin. Its best suited to treat Severe persistent acne in teenagers and adults

list.title: How long till I see visible results?
list.content: You can start seeing visible results in 3 to 4 weeks period.

list.title: What can I use after using the face wash?
list.content: We'd suggest following up with 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum, Gel-based moisturiser and sunscreen.
